snippet.title: Game Boy Color - Sesame Street - Elmo's 123s © 1999 NewKidCo - Gameplay
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
The fun and excitement of Game Boy comes to Preschoolers in this interactive adventure with Elmo. Children will delight in these games that help them develop number recognition, counting and basic addition and subtraction skills. Learning numbers is a journey of zooms, zips and blast-off fun with Elmo's 123s!
- Fully portable, Game Boy goes everywhere for skill-building fun!
- Grows with your child using 5 levels of play
- For children ages 3 to 6
